title: Prescribed-qbot retention-capacity attribution
observation: Exact K with derivative-consistent interpolated theta/C still gives 3 iterations versus 2 analytically in B01:wet prescribed-qbot.
question: Does restoring exact theta and C recover the analytical prescribed-qbot nonlinear path while K remains approximated?
variant: exact authoritative theta and C plus lookup K
case: B01:wet, bottom_mode=2, qbot=1e-6 cm/day, dt=0.01 day
decision_rule: Attribute the qbot convergence shift to retention/capacity approximation only if this variant restores 2 nonlinear iterations and 2 backtracking attempts while retaining the frozen state/mass gates.
